description: Wrapper-only minimization of the ultra-min BCJ package. The one-character payload files are preserved and the Python wrapper aliases repeated calls.

build.packaging: Ultra-min Python wrapper with one-character payload files.

basis: Same BCJ-filtered executable payload and same cmix-compressed dictionary as the parent package; only wrapper source changed.
deps: C++ runtime for the bundled cmix/fx2 binary

64k_inherited_from_bcj_parent.roundtrip_basis: Decoded cmix binary and dictionary payload are byte-identical to the current-driver verified BCJ parent package.

1m_inherited_from_bcj_parent.roundtrip_basis: Decoded cmix binary and dictionary payload are byte-identical to the current-driver verified BCJ parent package.

verdict: Promote as the current package-score leader for the old sidecar byte-split line. It preserves archive behavior and lowers counted payload versus v3 and the BCJ min parent.
